title: Nonunital Operator Systems as Modules in Enriched Category Theory
summary: An operator system is similar to a module over a ring, with the role of scalar multiplication played by the action of completely positive maps. Using enriched category theory, we make this analogy into a precise categorical equivalence, namely between a certain category of nonunital operator systems and a certain category of left modules over the category of matrix algebras enriched over regularly ordered Banach spaces. Using right modules instead yields an equivalence with a certain category of nonunital dual operator systems. We also develop general separation, representation and extension…
